biography.plain_text: Margulan Seisembayev is a Kazakh entrepreneur and investor who founded Seimar, expanding from trade into agriculture, banking and mobile telecommunications. He owned interests in Alliance Bank and the mobile operator Kartel before moving into private equity. As managing partner of Asadel Partners, he invests in agricultural businesses, food production and private education.

long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Margulan Seisembayev changed his approach to recruitment after losing money through business partners and counterparties. He came to favour developing staff internally, where he could observe their abilities, and required applicants to pass tests and interviews even when relatives or influential acquaintances recommended them.

His interest in travel later led him to create TravelMind for entrepreneurs. Early trips took participants into the Kazakh steppe, away from internet and mobile coverage. The programme combined outdoor challenges with discussions about business decisions. His team organised the routes and logistics, while he led group discussions in which participants examined their priorities and problems.
